item.title: BBC visits aftermath of Israeli strike on Lebanon that killed family as IDF targets Hezbollah
item.summary: A relative tells BBC those killed were civilians and not Hezbollah operatives, but the Israel Defence Forces says it was targeting "terrorist infrastructure".

item.title: Hamas urges key ally Iran to halt attacks on Gulf states
item.summary: The Palestinian group also affirms Tehran's right to defend itself from "aggression" by the US and Israel.

item.title: Russia exploiting Iran war, Zelensky says after fresh bombardment
item.summary: Volodymyr Zelensky cast concern over the supply of air-defence missiles after a heavy overnight attack kills at least five.

item.title: F1 cancels Bahrain & Saudi Arabia Grands Prix
item.summary: The Bahrain and Saudi Arabian Grand Prix weekends are cancelled because of the ongoing conflict in the Middle East.

item.title: More US Marines and warships being moved to Middle East, reports say
item.summary: The reinforcements will come from an amphibious ready group that is usually based in Japan, an official told CBS, the BBC's US partner.

item.title: Body of man found in wheelie bin 'after being hit by car'
item.summary: An urgent appeal has been issued by police to find out who the man is and how and where he died.

item.title: Why do Glasgow's historic buildings keep catching fire?
item.summary: The fire that devastated a building on Union Street is the latest in a series of blazes to strike the city's historic sites.

item.title: London's Burning actor John Alford dies in prison
item.summary: The 54-year-old former star of Grange Hill and London's Burning was found dead at HMP Bure in Norfolk.

item.title: Three more Iran football team members change minds over asylum
item.summary: Four of seven members of the women's football delegation who originally sought to stay in Australia have now chosen to return home.

item.title: Why has the US targeted Iran's Kharg Island?
item.summary: The tiny island is home to one of the most critical pieces of Iran's energy infrastructure.
